d:
Jan Suraaj Party’s digital media manager Devpalik Gupta was found dead near a railway track in Jharkhand after going missing from the Ranchi-Patna Jan Shatabdi Express on October 26. Police suspect he may have fallen from the moving train, but the exact cause of death is yet to be confirmed. Jan Suraaj leaders and the IIMC Alumni Association have demanded a thorough and impartial investigation.
